visual.description: Pure black used as the primary background across all sections of the site.
Near-black surface used for cards and content panels with slight elevation from the page background.
Very dark green-black base layer of the hero gradient background.
Deep teal-green forming the darker areas of the radial ambient glow in the hero and CTA sections.
Mid-tone teal-green visible as the core of the ambient radial glow effect in the hero.
Brighter teal-green at the brightest point of the radial glow, defining the brand accent color.
Deep blue variant of the ambient glow that appears in the footer/CTA section, shifting the brand accent.
Pure white used for all headings, large display text, and the primary logotype.
Off-white used for body copy and descriptive paragraph text throughout the site.
Medium grey used for secondary labels such as attribution text and footer copyright.
The nav bar appears transparent/black in both top and scrolled states against the dark page.
White used for nav link text in both the initial and scrolled nav states.
White nav link text persists unchanged after scrolling as background remains dark.
Dark charcoal grey used as the background for the code snippet card in the features section.
Bright green used for code syntax highlighting in the terminal/API snippet card.
White used for button borders on the outlined/ghost call-to-action buttons.
Light grey used for subtle borders on utility icon buttons.
Very dark grey vertical divider line separating the scroll-pinned sections.
